scenes.setting: Sunday morning, home on Daffodil Street: quick breakfast, a sleepy Melissa on the stairs mentions Mass at Saint Selena Cathedral; Klein heads to his room
scenes.text_anchor: After thinking for a while, Klein decided to return home to confirm something.

scenes.setting: Above the gray fog (visions only: the puppet's vertical-eye paper; the brown-haired young man praying in Jotun): divination confirms the eye is key to the Antigonus treasure
scenes.text_anchor: Immediately following that, he psyched himself up and took out the ritual dagger

scenes.setting: Lunch at home: Melissa dresses up for a household-affairs lecture with Selena and Elizabeth; Benson wrestles with grammar books
scenes.text_anchor: Klein slept all the way till half-past twelve

scenes.setting: Blackthorn reception hall: Rozanne and Dunn are surprised to see Klein back; Dunn wordlessly leads him toward the office
scenes.text_anchor: At two in the afternoon, Klein arrived at the Blackthorn Security Company again.

scenes.setting: Dunn's office: the notebook is reclassified Grade 1 — above both their clearances — and 3-0625's seal has been changed
scenes.text_anchor: Klein shut the door, and Dunn sniffed his smoking pipe

scenes.setting: Municipal hall: Melissa, Selena and Elizabeth wait for the family-affairs lecture, plotting to sneak out to Harrods if it's boring
